title: No hea mai nā ʻōlelo?
invitation: E ʻike i ka lāʻau ʻohana ma hope o nā ʻōlelo aʻo 104 a Gef, a me nā ʻāpana o ka mōʻaukala ʻōlelo ʻaʻole kūpono loa i hoʻokahi lāʻau wale nō.
summary: Hoʻolilo nā ʻōlelo i nā ʻano mai nā ʻōlelo kahiko, hōʻaiʻē mai nā hoalauna, neʻe pū me nā kānaka, a loli ke hana nā kaiāulu i mau ʻano a me nā kūlana hou. Hoʻolālā kēia haʻawina i nā ʻōlelo 104 a Gef me ka hoʻokaʻawale pono ʻana i ka moʻokūʻauhau, ka ʻāina, ke kākau ʻana, a me ka politika.

localization_keys.completion_title: He mōʻaukala ka lāʻau, ʻaʻole he pae kiʻekiʻe

atlas_labels.title: Atlas ʻohana ʻōlelo a Gef
atlas_labels.description: Hōʻike ʻia kēlā me kēia ʻike ʻōlelo aʻo o kēia manawa hoʻokahi wale nō manawa. ʻAʻole hana nā ʻano palapala, ʻāina, unuhi-leka, a kōkua heluhelu i ʻōlelo hou. Hōʻike kaʻawale ʻia nā ʻōlelo pilina no ka mea ʻaʻole lawa hoʻokahi lālā makua e wehewehe i ko lākou hoʻokumu ʻana.
atlas_labels.accessibility_label: Atlas ʻohana ʻōlelo me nā ʻōlelo aʻo 104 a Gef

notes.atlantic_congo: He inoa ākea i hoʻohana ʻia me ka mālama no nā ʻōlelo Gef i hōʻike ʻia ma ʻaneʻi. Hoʻohana nui ʻia nō hoʻi ʻo Niger-Congo; ʻaʻole like ka paʻa o ka hoʻokaʻawale kiʻekiʻe ma nā wahi a pau.
notes.basque: Manaʻo ʻia ka ʻōlelo Basque he ʻōlelo kaʻawale no ka mea ʻaʻole i hōʻoia ka hana hoʻohālikelike i kekahi ʻohana moʻokūʻauhau ākea aʻe.

atlas_labels.contact_note: Hoʻohui ʻia ma muli o ko lākou moʻolelo hoʻokumu, ʻaʻole i koi ʻia ma lalo o hoʻokahi lālā makua. Hōʻike ko lākou ulu ʻana i ka pilina ʻōlelo he nui a me ka hana hou a nā kaiāulu.

blocks.title: He kūpuna ko kēlā me kēia ʻōlelo
blocks.text: ʻAʻole haku ʻia nā ʻōlelo i hoʻokahi manawa. Aʻo nā keiki i ka ʻōlelo mai nā kānaka ʻē aʻe; hoʻololi iki kēlā me kēia hanauna i nā leo a me ka grammar; neʻe a hui nā kaiāulu; hele pū nā huaʻōlelo me nā kānaka. I nā kenekulia, hiki i hoʻokahi ʻano kahiko ke māhele i mau ʻōlelo hou. He pili kokoke kekahi, he pili mamao kekahi, a he hoalauna wale nō kekahi. He 104 ʻōlelo aʻo ko Gef i kēia manawa; ʻo kēia haʻawina ka palapala ʻāina ma hope o kēlā palapala ʻāina.

blocks.title: ʻO ka ʻohana ʻōlelo ka hoʻoilina
blocks.text: Hoʻohālikelike nā kānaka kālai ʻōlelo mōʻaukala i nā kūlike leo maʻamau, nā huaʻōlelo kumu, ka morphology, a me nā ʻano grammar e hoʻāʻo ai i ka hoʻoilina mai hoʻokahi kūpuna pū. ʻAʻole lawa hoʻokahi huaʻōlelo like no ka mea hōʻaiʻē mau nā ʻōlelo. No laila he Germanic ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia, he Indo-European ka Persian, he Afro-Asiatic ka Arabic, a he Austroasiatic ka Vietnamese. ʻO ka ʻohana he moʻokūʻauhau, ʻaʻole he ʻāina, lāhui, pīʻāpā, a hanohano paha.

blocks.title: Atlas ʻohana ʻōlelo a Gef
blocks.description: Hōʻike ʻia nā ʻike ʻōlelo aʻo 104 o kēia manawa hoʻokahi wale nō manawa.

blocks.title: Indo-European: he ʻohana nui ma nā ʻāina nui
blocks.text: ʻOi aku ma mua o ka hapalua o nā ʻōlelo aʻo o Gef i ka ʻohana Indo-European. Aia nā lālā Germanic, Romance, Slavic, Baltic, a Celtic ma ʻEulopa; hele hohonu nā lālā Indo-Aryan a Iranian i ʻĀkia Hema a me ʻĀkia Komohana-Hema. Hōʻike ka ʻōlelo Helene i ka lālā Hellenic; he lālā nui ponoʻī ko Armenian a me Albanian. He pili moʻokūʻauhau mamao ko Hindi a me Pelekānia; ʻaʻole pēlā ʻo Arabic a me Persian.

blocks.title: ʻĀkia Hikina a me Hema-Hikina: ʻaʻole pili koko nā hoalauna a pau
blocks.text: ʻO Mandarin Chinese a me Cantonese nā ʻōlelo Sinitic i loko o ka ʻohana Sino-Tibetan; aia ʻo Burmese ma kekahi lālā ʻē aʻe o ia ʻohana ākea. He Japonic ka Kepanī a he Koreanic ka Kōlea. Ua nui ka mana o ke kākau Kina a me nā huaʻōlelo Kina i nā mea ʻelua, akā ʻaʻole hoʻololi ka mana i ka moʻokūʻauhau. He Austroasiatic ʻo Vietnamese a me Khmer; he mau ʻōlelo Tai ʻo Thai, Lao, a Shan ma Kra-Dai. Hōʻike ka lāʻau ʻohana i ke kumu; hōʻike ka palapala pilina i ke kamaʻilio ʻana.

blocks.title: ʻĀkia Komohana a Waena: he mau lāʻau i ulana pū ʻia
blocks.text: ʻO nā ʻōlelo Turkic a Gef ʻo Turkish, Azerbaijani, Bashkir, Chuvash, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Turkmen, a Uzbek. He Mongolic ka Mongolian, ʻaʻole Turkic. He mea hoʻopaʻapaʻa ka manaʻo kahiko e hoʻohui i nā ʻohana Turkic a me Mongolic ma lalo o ka ʻohana “Altaic”; ʻaʻole aʻo ʻo Gef i ia mea he moʻokūʻauhau paʻa. He Uralic ʻo Estonian, Finnish, a Hungarian. Ma Caucasus, he Kartvelian ka Georgian, he Indo-European ka Armenian, a he Turkic ka Azerbaijani.

blocks.title: ʻApelika a me ka Hikina Waena: he ʻokoʻa hohonu ma hope o nā inoa kamaʻāina
blocks.text: Ma Afro-Asiatic, he Semitic ʻo Arabic, Hebrew, Amharic, a Tigrinya; he Chadic ʻo Hausa; he Cushitic ʻo Somali a me Oromo. Hōʻike ʻo Gef iā Swahili, Akan, Igbo, Yoruba, a Zulu ma loko o ka ʻōnaehana ākea Atlantic-Congo me ka mālama i ka hoʻokaʻawale kiʻekiʻe. Nui loa aku nā ʻohana ʻōlelo a me nā ʻōlelo kaʻawale o ʻApelika ma mua o ka mea a Gef e hōʻike nei i kēia manawa.

blocks.title: Austronesian: nā hoahānau i pālahalaha ma ke ao kai
blocks.text: He Austronesian ʻo Indonesian, Malay, Javanese, Filipino, a Hawaiian. Kōkua ka holo moana, ka neʻe ʻana, ke kālepa, ka male, ka noho ʻana, ke kula, a me nā kulekele aupuni e wehewehe i ko lākou wahi i ʻōlelo ʻia ai i kēia lā. ʻAʻole like ka ʻike ʻōlelo o kahi huahana me kahi lālā hohonu o ka lāʻau ʻohana: pili loa ʻo Indonesian a me Malay ma ke ʻano he mau ʻōlelo maʻamau; mamao loa aku ka Hawaiian i loko o ka ʻohana nui hoʻokahi.

blocks.title: ʻOi aku ma mua o hoʻokahi ʻohana nui ma ʻĀkia Hema
blocks.text: He Indo-Aryan a no laila Indo-European ka nui o nā ʻōlelo Gef ma ka ʻākau o ʻĀkia Hema. Aia ʻo Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, a Kannada ma ka ʻohana Dravidian kūʻokoʻa. Ua hana nā kenekulia o ka pilina i nā huaʻōlelo hōʻaiʻē a me nā ʻano ʻāina pū me ka holoi ʻole i nā kumu ʻokoʻa. ʻO ka ʻōlelo “ʻōlelo India” he wehewehe ʻāina a i ʻole ʻaupuni, ʻaʻole hoʻokahi ʻohana ʻōlelo.

blocks.title: He mōʻaukala piha ko nā ʻohana liʻiliʻi a me nā ʻōlelo kaʻawale
blocks.text: He Quechuan ka Quechua, he Kartvelian ka Georgian, he Mongolic ka Mongolian, he Japonic ka Japanese, a he Koreanic ka Korean. Inā hoʻokahi wale nō lālā o kahi ʻohana ma Gef, ʻaʻole ia e hoʻēmi i ka waiwai o ia ʻohana. Manaʻo ʻia ka Basque he isolate no ka mea ʻaʻole i hōʻoia ʻia kekahi ʻohana nui aʻe. ʻAʻole ka ʻōlelo kaʻawale he ʻōlelo kahiko loa a emi paha kona hoʻomohala ʻana.

blocks.title: ʻOi aku ka maikaʻi o kekahi mōʻaukala ke kaha ʻia he pūnaewele
blocks.text: Ua ulu ʻo Nigerian Pidgin a me Haitian Creole ma loko o ka pilina ʻōlelo he nui. ʻO ka Pelekānia ke kumu huaʻōlelo mōʻaukala nui o Nigerian Pidgin a ʻo ka Palani no Haitian Creole, akā hōʻike pū nā ʻōlelo ʻelua i nā ʻano, nā ʻike, nā hana hou, a me nā ʻōlelo ʻē aʻe o nā kaiāulu nāna lāua i hoʻokumu. No laila hōʻike ʻo Gef iā lāua ma lalo o ka mōʻaukala pilina, ʻaʻole ma lalo o hoʻokahi lālā makua i koi ʻia.

blocks.title: Hiki i ke kākau ke hoʻopunipuni i ka maka
blocks.text: He ʻenehana nā ʻōnaehana kākau; he moʻokūʻauhau nā ʻohana ʻōlelo. Hiki i nā ʻōlelo pili ʻole ke hoʻohana i ka palapala like, a hiki i nā ʻōlelo pili ke hoʻohana i nā palapala ʻokoʻa. Hoʻohana ʻo Arabic, Persian, Urdu, a me Sorani Kurdish i nā palapala pili i hoʻokumu ʻia ma Arabic, akā he Afro-Asiatic ka Arabic a he Indo-European nā mea ʻē aʻe. Hiki ke kākau ʻo Serbian ma Cyrillic a i ʻole Latin. Ma Gef, ʻaʻole hoʻonui nā ʻano palapala, transliteration, a kōkua heluhelu i ka helu 104.

blocks.title: No ke aha e neʻe, māhele, hui, a hōʻaiʻē ai nā ʻōlelo
blocks.text: Hoʻololi ke kālepa, nā aupuni nui, nā hoʻomana, ka neʻe ʻana, nā kūlanakauhale, nā kula, ka pāpaho, a me nā aupuni i ka ʻāina ʻōlelo. ʻAʻole maluhia mau ka hoʻolaha ʻōlelo: ʻo ka hoʻoneʻe koi, kauā, lanakila kaua, koloniala, nā kulekele hoʻohui, a me ka hakakā a nā kaiāulu e mālama a hoʻōla hou i kā lākou ʻōlelo he ʻāpana nō o ka mōʻaukala. Aia nā kānaka ma hope o kēlā me kēia laina ma ka palapala ʻāina.

blocks.title: Ma hea e pau ai kekahi ʻōlelo a hoʻomaka kekahi?
blocks.text: Wehewehe ka moʻokūʻauhau i ka pili mōʻaukala, akā ʻaʻole ia wale nō e hoʻoholo i nā inoa ʻōlelo o kēia au. He mea nui hoʻi ka moʻokalaleo, ka hoʻonaʻauao, nā hui, ka lāhui, ka politika, nā kūlana kākau, a me ka ʻike ponoʻī o nā mea ʻōlelo. He mau kūlana South Slavic pili loa ʻo Bosnian, Croatian, a Serbian, akā he mau ʻike hou kaʻawale ma Gef. ʻElua mau kūlana kākau Norwegian ʻo Bokmål a me Nynorsk. Pili loa ke kumu ʻōlelo o Hindi a me Urdu, akā hiki ke ʻokoʻa ke kākau, ke kūlana ʻōlelo, a me ka mōʻaukala moʻomeheu.

blocks.title: Pehea kākou e ʻike ai i nā kūpuna i hoʻopaʻa ʻole ʻia?
blocks.text: Hoʻohana nā kānaka kālai ʻōlelo mōʻaukala i ke ʻano hoʻohālikelike. Hoʻohālikelike lākou i nā ʻōlelo, ʻike i nā kūlike leo maʻamau a me nā ʻāpana grammar like, a kūkulu hou i nā ʻano e wehewehe maikaʻi ai i nā ʻōlelo mamo. He hōʻike nāwaliwali hoʻokahi huaʻōlelo kupaianaha i like; ʻoi aku ka ikaika o kahi ʻano e hoʻi hou ana ma nā huaʻōlelo kumu a me nā ʻano he nui. Kapa ʻia ka kūpuna i kūkulu hou ʻia he proto-language. He kūkulu ʻepekema ʻo Proto-Indo-European, ʻaʻole he leo i hoʻopaʻa ʻia. ʻOi aku ka mamao i ka wā kahiko, ʻoi aku ka nui o ka kānalua.

blocks.title: He mōʻaukala ka lāʻau, ʻaʻole he pae kiʻekiʻe
blocks.description: I kēia manawa aia iā ʻoe ka palapala ʻāina ma hope o ka palapala ʻāina: 104 ʻōlelo, nā ʻohana he nui, a me nā moʻolelo pilina i ʻoi aku ka maikaʻi o ka pūnaewele ma mua o ka lāʻau i kekahi manawa. ʻAʻole manaʻo ka pili ʻohana he ʻoi aku ka maikaʻi, maʻemaʻe, maʻalahi, a koʻikoʻi paha o kekahi ʻōlelo. Inā like nā ʻōlelo ʻelua, e nīnau: he hoʻoilina pū a he pilina mōʻaukala paha?
